::: {.lead}
A clinical decision-support system for progesterone receptor (PR) status classification
in breast cancer, integrating RNA-Seq transcriptomic profiles with whole-slide imaging
via a novel asymmetric cross-attention architecture.
:::

**Key contributions:**

- $O(N)$ asymmetric cross-attention resolves the structural incompatibility between
  fixed-length genomic vectors and variable-length WSI patch bags.
- **Top-1%-Mass Concentration** metric — a slide-size-invariant alternative to Shannon
  entropy — recovers $p = 0.018$ phenotypic separation that entropy analysis suppresses
  ($p = 0.401$).
- **Cross-Modal Reliability Estimator** (Gated-Fusion v2) provides a per-patient
  $\alpha \in (0,1)$ signal for automated triage of IHC-discordant borderline cases.
- +0.0745 ROC-AUC over the late fusion baseline, attributed to genomic conditioning
  *upstream* of visual compression.
